assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, including dimension zero. V is real-valued and C²; α,β are nonnegative reals.
Exactly six analytic source hypotheses: α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative bound.

Standing E,V,α,β,η are fixed. y,xRef,z0,t,sample are arguments of one jointly Borel map. P and ε are literal canonical definitions; measurability, positive support, recurrence, cover and nonaccumulation are produced dependencies.

The deterministic covered-arc characterization and uncovered fallback hold for every sample. Actual all-time agreement and initialization hold on one AE sample event for each fixed parameter triple. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The initial-phase fallback is an explicitly labelled ASTIS measurable extension only on the uncovered complement; zero-time exceptional bounces need not have source index0 at t0.
units.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. This is an ASTIS source-implicit measurable realization of Appendix A.1's actual between-jump prescription, not the full process/Markov/invariance/main sampler/error/query-cost/composition theorem. No positive dimension, energy, cap, selector, nonexplosion, positive support, measurable flow or higher regularity certificate is a new premise.

steps.title: Retain actual source objects
steps.text: Use the canonical Exp1 sample, actual NNReal thresholds, harmonic flow, reflection, integrated hazard, hitting time and guarded stopped recurrence. No witness or measurable clock is supplied as an extra assumption.
steps.lean:
classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
    fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
      (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)

steps.title: Pull back the measurable actual records and clocks
steps.text: The verified finite-record theorem supplies joint measurability of every finite stopped record and clock. Coordinate clamping is measurable, so composition gives joint measurable maps in parameters, physical time and the real-sequence sample. The verified harmonic-flow theorem supplies joint measurable harmonic flow and Phi0=id.
steps.lean:
have h76 := ActualFiniteJumpRecursion.actual_fixed_reference_finite_jump_recursion
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  rcases h76 with ⟨hinit, _, _, hrecordM, htimeM, hmono, _, _, _, hstrict⟩
  have hflow := ActualHarmonicFlow.actual_harmonic_flow_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hΦM : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × ℝ × (E × E) =>
      Φ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) := hflow.2.1
  have hΦ0 : ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, Φ y xRef 0 z = z := hflow.2.2.1
  have hεM : Measurable ε := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun n =>
    measurable_real_toNNReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply n)
  let A := ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ)
  let args : A → (E × E) × (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ≥0) :=
    fun a => (a.1.1, a.1.2, ε a.2.2)
  have hargs : Measurable args := measurable_fst.fst.prodMk
    (measurable_fst.snd.prodMk (hεM.comp measurable_snd.snd))
  have hrM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun a : A =>
      record a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n) := (hrecordM n).comp hargs
  have hTM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun a : A =>
      eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n) := (htimeM n).comp hargs
  have htM : Measurable (fun a : A => (a.2.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) :=
    WithTop.measurable_coe.comp measurable_snd.fst

steps.title: Build disjoint measurable half-open intervals
steps.text: Order comparison makes each D_n measurable for all inputs. Actual clock monotonicity implies that if n<m, then t<T_(n+1)≤T_m≤t would contradict simultaneous membership. Nonaccumulation is not used to prove this deterministic measurability or disjointness.
steps.lean:
let D : ℕ → Set A := fun n => {a |
    eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n ≤ (a.2.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
    (a.2.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) (n + 1)}
  have hDM (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (D n) :=
    (measurableSet_le (hTM n) htM).inter (measurableSet_lt htM (hTM (n + 1)))
  have hdisj (n m : ℕ) (a : A) (hn : a ∈ D n) (hm : a ∈ D m) : n = m := by
    have hmon : Monotone (eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2)) :=
      (hmono a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2)).2
    rcases lt_trichotomy n m with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hm.1) (hn.2.trans_le (hmon (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt))))
    · exact heq
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn.1) (hm.2.trans_le (hmon (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgt))))

steps.title: Make the finite harmonic branch measurable
steps.text: The auxiliary Sum projection is total with a dummy zero branch only to define a Borel branch everywhere. A selected D_n cannot have a stopped nth record because its left clock is at most finite t. Thus the dummy never supplies the source phase. NNReal elapsed subtraction and the exact harmonic formula give joint Borel branch maps.
steps.lean:
-- This total auxiliary projection is used only on D_n, where the record is live.
  -- Its zero branch never supplies a source phase for a stopped record.
  let L : ℕ → A → ℝ≥0 × (E × E) := fun n a =>
    (record a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n).elim id (fun _ => (0, (0, 0)))
  have hLM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (L n) :=
    (measurable_id.sumElim measurable_const).comp (hrM n)
  let branch : ℕ → A → E × E := fun n a =>
    Φ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 ((a.2.1 - (L n a).1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) (L n a).2
  have hbM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (branch n) :=
    hΦM.comp (measurable_fst.fst.prodMk
      ((measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (measurable_snd.fst.sub (hLM n).fst)).prodMk
        (hLM n).snd))

steps.title: Glue countably many branches and the explicit complement
steps.text: Use Option naturals: some n indexes D_n, none indexes the measurable uncovered complement. The none value is the initial phase coordinate z0. All sets are disjoint, so their values agree on overlaps. Pinned Mathlib countable measurable piecewise assembly proves existence of a total Borel realization.
steps.lean:
let sets : Option ℕ → Set A
    | none => (⋃ n, D n)ᶜ
    | some n => D n
  let values : Option ℕ → A → E × E
    | none => fun a => a.1.2
    | some n => branch n
  have hsM (i : Option ℕ) : MeasurableSet (sets i) := by
    cases i with
    | none => exact (MeasurableSet.iUnion hDM).compl
    | some n => exact hDM n
  have hvM (i : Option ℕ) : Measurable (values i) := by
    cases i with
    | none => exact measurable_fst.snd
    | some n => exact hbM n
  have hcompat : Pairwise (fun i j => Set.EqOn (values i) (values j) (sets i ∩ sets j)) := by
    intro i j hij a ha
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact False.elim (hij rfl)
      | some m => exact False.elim (ha.1 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, ha.2⟩))
    | some n =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact False.elim (ha.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, ha.1⟩))
      | some m => exact False.elim (hij (congrArg some (hdisj n m a ha.1 ha.2)))

steps.title: Realize one joint phase map and its actual covered arcs
steps.text: Curry the proved measurable f into Z. On every actual covering interval, piecewise agreement selects the nth branch. Rewriting the actual live-record equality removes the dummy Sum branch and gives the exact finite elapsed harmonic interpolation. This deterministic characterization holds for all samples.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨f, hfM, hf⟩ := exists_measurable_piecewise sets hsM values hvM hcompat
  let Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E) :=
    fun y xRef z₀ t sample => f (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample)
  have hZ (y xRef : E) (z₀ : E × E) (sample : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0)
      (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E))
      (hl : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0))
      (hu : (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1))
      (hr : record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a) :
      Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 := by
    have heq := hf (some n) (show (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample) ∈ sets (some n) from ⟨hl, hu⟩)
    change f (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample) = _
    rw [heq]
    dsimp [values, branch, L]
    rw [hr]
    rfl

steps.title: Certify the uncovered representative convention
steps.text: If no interval covers a pair, it lies in the none set. Piecewise agreement gives Z=z0 there. This is a declared ASTIS exceptional extension and is not used for a last live arc with an infinite next wait.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨Z, hfM, hZ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y xRef z₀ sample t hn
    exact hf none (show (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample) ∈ sets none from by
      intro hx
      obtain ⟨n, hnD⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact hn ⟨n, hnD⟩)

steps.title: Obtain actual interpolation simultaneously at every finite time
steps.text: For each fixed parameter triple use the verified interval-cover theorem on its common AE sample event, together with the canonical positive-input support. At every finite t, the verified interval-cover theorem supplies the actual covering index and live record, its stored time≤t and elapsed below the next wait. The deterministic characterization gives actual Z agreement on that same event.
steps.formula: \forall(y,x_{\rm ref},z_0),\quad P\text{-a.s. }\forall t<\infty,\quad\exists n,a:\ T_n\le t<T_{n+1},\quad t-a.time<\tau(a.phase,\varepsilon_n),\quad Z_t=\Phi_{t-a.time}(a.phase).
steps.lean:
· intro y xRef z₀
    have hc := ActualPhysicalTimeCover.actual_fixed_reference_physical_time_cover
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y xRef z₀
    have hp := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.2.2.2.1
    filter_upwards [hc, hp] with sample hcover hpositive
    constructor
    · intro t
      obtain ⟨n, hn, huniq⟩ := hcover.1 t
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hau⟩ := hcover.2 t n hn.1 hn.2
      exact ⟨n, a, hn.1, hn.2, ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2,
        hZ y xRef z₀ sample t n a hn.1 hn.2 ha.1⟩

steps.title: Derive source initialization from actual positive input
steps.text: The initial record is (0,z0). Actual epsilon0 is strictly positive AE by the proved canonical input law. If record1 is stopped its clock is infinity; otherwise the actual finite recursion strict increment gives T1>0. Hence interval0 contains physical0. The covered formula and Phi0=id yield Z0=z0, without asserting initialization for every exceptional real sequence.
steps.lean:
· have hi0 : record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 0 = Sum.inl (0, z₀) :=
        hinit y xRef z₀ (ε sample)
      have hT0 : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 0 = 0 :=
        (hmono y xRef z₀ (ε sample)).1
      have hepos : 0 < ε sample 0 := Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr (hpositive 0).1
      have hfirst : (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 1 := by
        cases hr1 : record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 1 with
        | inr u =>
          change (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) <
            (record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 1).elim (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
          rw [hr1]
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_top (0 : ℝ≥0)
        | inl b =>
          have hbpos : 0 < b.1 :=
            (hstrict y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 0 (0, z₀) hi0).2 b hepos hr1
          change (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) <
            (record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 1).elim (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
          rw [hr1]
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr hbpos
      have heq := hZ y xRef z₀ sample 0 0 (0, z₀)
        (by rw [hT0]; rfl) hfirst hi0
      simpa only [tsub_zero, NNReal.coe_zero, hΦ0] using heq
